title: SWAP core invariant audit for standard WOFOST evolution readiness

3_explicit_data_separation.evidence: immutable parameters, physical committed crop state, reference-oracle compatibility memory, event forcing, accepted aggregates, ordinary rates/workspace, results and diagnostics are explicitly distinguished

4_compact_persistent_state.evidence: physical continuation is minimal, derived LAI/WLV/LASUM/ILV are excluded, optional vernalization/root state scales with use, and exact-code compatibility uses at most narrow conditional scalars instead of the full WOFOST_rates object

5_scratch_per_worker.evidence: ordinary dtsum/dvr/daylp and growth/death/allocation rates are event/worker-local; only the two proven cross-event SAVE exceptions are modeled as narrow reference compatibility memory

6_scalable_memory_layout.evidence: SoA/pools/batches, compact active cohorts and sparse/conditional compatibility sidecars remain permitted

7_transactional_time_steps.evidence: complete enabled physical crop continuation and enabled exact-reference compatibility memory are candidate-local; F-KT remains the only publication/rollback authority

8_cheap_recalculation_and_warm_start.evidence: same checkpoint, forcing, accepted aggregates and enabled compatibility memory must replay identically; worker warm starts cannot replace physical origin

9_generic_time.evidence: kernel time stays generic [t0,t1]; standard WOFOST first uses an explicit one-day process event; arbitrary dt substitution remains forbidden

10_flexible_coupling_windows.evidence: crop windows are runtime events and accepted aggregates may span smaller kernel/coupling intervals without a MODFLOW or midnight primitive
10_flexible_coupling_windows.hold: production runtime window-accumulator persistence across smaller commits is not implemented by F-WOF25

11_coupling_core_functionality.evidence: crop evolution consumes only accepted process results under the common transaction lineage

13_absolute_mass_conservation.evidence: IQROT/IPTRA/IALPWET are read-only crop inputs after accepted accumulation; root-water mass remains exactly-once under F-KT/F-MR

16_MultiSWAP_primary_use_case.evidence: execution classes can group physical options and exact-reference compatibility requirements while sharing immutable crop parameters

21_reuse_SWAP_physics.evidence: source WOFOST assimilation, phenology, allocation, cohort and root semantics are preserved as the reference basis

23_physics_solver_policy_separation.evidence: IDSL/SWRD/SWRDC/oxygen remain physical options. Reference compatibility memory belongs to the exact-code reference execution path and may not silently change physical configuration.

25_reference_mode_available.evidence: B1.10 one-day cadence remains the reference oracle and the GLAIEXP/VERNRATE SAVE carryovers are now explicit rather than silently discarded
25_reference_mode_available.qualification_rule: a candidate claiming exact code continuation must transport those narrow carryovers where applicable; a corrected-theory path must instead register and qualify the discrepancy

26_runtime_diagnostics.evidence: event diagnostics and lineage/aggregate provenance are explicit; production fields remain for the structural candidate

27_optional_functionality_scales_with_us.evidence: IDSL2, adaptive root state, potential shadow, nutrient/grass state and exact-reference compatibility sidecars are only present where active

28_runtime_coupler_system_composition.evidence: crop scheduling, crop-window aggregation and calendar translation remain outside the crop kernel

29_no_hidden_dependencies.evidence: no hidden daynr/t1900/calendar globals, file assumptions, midnight dependency or Richards-substep-equals-crop-day rule is admitted

30_every_architecture_change_audited.evidence: state, compatibility memory, event API, cadence, transactions, MultiSWAP and cross-process aggregation are audited before production implementation
